title: Urban Threads - Fashion Store
summary: Custom Shopify 2.0 theme with quick-view, size guide and ajax cart for a fashion brand.
description: Dummy description: Yahan apne project ka detail likhein. Is project mein humne ek custom Shopify 2.0 theme banayi jis mein ajax cart drawer, product quick view, size guide popup aur predictive search shamil hain. Store speed aur conversion rate ko dhyan mein rakh kar optimize kiya gaya.
challenges: Purani theme se 1,200+ products migrate karna aur page speed 90+ score par rakhna.
results: Conversion rate 28% barha aur page load time 3.4s se 1.6s ho gaya.

title: Gadget Hub - Electronics Store
summary: Electronics store with product comparison, bundles and email automation.
description: Dummy description: Electronics store jis mein product comparison table, bundle offers aur Klaviyo email flows integrate kiye gaye.
challenges: Custom bundle pricing without paid apps.

title: Nexa Corp - Corporate Website
summary: Fast multilingual corporate website with custom post types and ACF blocks.
description: Dummy description: Corporate website jis mein custom theme, ACF flexible content, multilingual support (WPML) aur SEO optimization ki gayi.
challenges: Elementor ke bagair lightweight design aur 95+ Lighthouse score.

title: FreshCart - WooCommerce Grocery
summary: Online grocery with delivery slots, area-wise pricing and custom checkout.
description: Dummy description: WooCommerce par based grocery store jis mein delivery time slots, area wise delivery charges aur custom checkout flow banaya gaya.
challenges: Real-time stock sync with POS system.

title: EduPro - School Management System
summary: Multi-branch school ERP: students, fees, attendance, exams and parent portal.
description: Dummy description: Laravel par based school management system jis mein role-based access, fee vouchers, attendance, result cards aur parent/teacher portals hain.
challenges: Multi-branch data isolation aur bulk PDF generation.

title: LeadFlow - CRM & REST API
summary: CRM backend with REST API, queues, webhooks and role-based dashboards.
description: Dummy description: Sales teams ke liye CRM jis ka REST API Laravel Sanctum se secure hai aur Redis queues par emails/webhooks chalte hain.
challenges: High volume lead import (100k rows) without timeouts.

title: ShopSphere - React Storefront
summary: Headless e-commerce storefront with cart, wishlist and Stripe checkout.
description: Dummy description: React aur Redux Toolkit par based headless storefront jo REST API se connected hai, Stripe checkout aur wishlist ke saath.
challenges: Large catalog par smooth filtering aur infinite scroll.

title: InsightBoard - Analytics Dashboard
summary: Realtime analytics dashboard with charts, filters and export options.
description: Dummy description: TypeScript + React dashboard jis mein live charts, date filters aur CSV/PDF export hai.
challenges: Heavy charts par re-render optimize karna.

title: PeopleHub - HR & Payroll Portal
summary: HR system with payroll, leave management, attendance and employee self-service.
description: Dummy description: ASP.NET Core MVC par based HR portal jis mein payroll calculation, leave workflow, attendance machine integration aur reports shamil hain.
challenges: Complex tax slabs aur arrears calculation.

title: StockMate - Inventory Web API
summary: Inventory and POS API with JWT auth, Swagger docs and background jobs.
description: Dummy description: Clean architecture par based Web API jis mein JWT auth, Dapper queries aur Hangfire background jobs hain.
challenges: Concurrent stock updates mein race conditions.

title: OpsCenter - ERP Frontend
summary: Modular ERP frontend with lazy-loaded modules, NgRx store and role-based UI.
description: Dummy description: Angular 17 standalone components, NgRx state management aur Angular Material par based ERP frontend.
challenges: Bohat bari tables par virtual scrolling.

title: BookIt - Appointment Booking
summary: PWA booking app with realtime availability and push notifications.
description: Dummy description: Angular PWA jis mein Firebase realtime database, calendar slots aur push notifications hain.
challenges: Double booking se bachna realtime mein.
